## About
Lilac Dental of Austin is a family dental office in North Austin, led by a husband-and-wife team who call Austin home. Dr. Kiranmayee Yanala is our lead dentist, and Dr. Suman Kondragunta, who most patients call Dr. K, practices alongside her.
We see children coming in for their first visit and adults looking after their long-term oral health. Preventive, restorative, cosmetic and pediatric care all happen here, and we take the time to explain what we find so you leave knowing your next steps.
Patients have given us a 5 star rating across 139 Google reviews. Some of them came to us nervous, and we try to make every visit feel calm and judgment free.

## Services
- Dental checkups: A careful look at your teeth, gums and bite, with findings explained without rushing.
- Teeth cleaning: Our hygiene team clears away buildup and polishes off surface stains.
- Same day emergency dentistry: Help for toothaches, broken teeth and other urgent dental problems.
- Invisalign: Clear aligners that straighten teeth quietly, planned around your smile goals.
- Teeth whitening: Professional whitening that lifts the stains daily brushing can't.
- Lumineers: Ultra-thin veneers that improve your smile without the extensive prep of traditional veneers.
- Dental implants: Durable, natural-looking replacements for missing teeth.
- Root canal treatment: Treatment that clears infection from a damaged tooth and helps save it.
- Custom dentures: Dentures made to fit comfortably so eating and speaking feel easier.
- Pediatric dentistry: Gentle, positive dental visits for children, from their very first checkup.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take dental insurance?
A: Yes. We accept major insurance providers, including Delta Dental, Cigna, MetLife and UnitedHealth.

Q: Do you offer emergency dentistry?
A: Yes. Same day emergency dentistry is one of the things our office is known for, so give us a call if something comes up.

Q: Do you offer payment options?
A: Yes. We offer flexible payment options with PPO plans to help treatment fit your budget.
